reason: The expanded 641c448..db6f32c full correctness audit confirmed four recorder-glibc production defects, six test gaps, and four clarity issues. The production findings add supported regex branches and fresh end-to-end cases, so review policy returned all fourteen findings to one coordinated implementation slice.

boundary.startingEvent: A startup MSGTYPE/AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION pattern is compiled or matched, or an initialized pline/autounlock consumer reaches one of the audited branches.
boundary.endingEvent: The rule is accepted or diagnosed exactly, matching and message/autounlock behavior reaches the next input boundary with source-shaped state, and all fourteen audited contracts are pinned.
boundary.validInputs: Recorder-glibc ASCII ERE including numeric references, comma-only intervals, GNU buffer anchors, contextual caret/dollar on newline text, long UTF-8 messages, urgent/NOREP/STOP combinations, and combined autounlock masks.
boundary.observables: Regex diagnostics and match result, installed MSGTYPE action, message history, queued input consumption, terminal screens/attributes/cursors, autounlock boundary, and PRNG calls.
boundary.exclusions: Non-ASCII C.UTF-8 locale matching, runtime autopickup object filtering, interactive MSGTYPE editing/serialization, USER_SOUNDS, and custompline flags other than exact OVERRIDE remain named before-effect boundaries.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: sys/share/posixregex.c regex_compile/regex_match as supplied by recorder glibc, options.c msgtype_type/msgtype_add, pline.c vpline/urgent_pline/Norep, lock.c doopen_indir, and wintty.c message-window display/clear.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: The glibc ERE operators exercised by the direct oracle, MSGTYPE action table, autounlock bit constants, pline flags, and BUFSZ define the finite candidate families.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: Five audit finders traced candidates through config parsing, compiled state, live classification, TTY waits/history, and the locked-door consumer; two adjudicators verified all seventeen deduplicated candidates and confirmed these fourteen.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: The audit inspected js/posixregex.js, js/options.js, js/tty_message.js, js/hack.js, startup runners/oracles, and focused tests for mismatches and non-discriminating assertions.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: This checklist is exhaustive for the fourteen confirmed findings recorded at review frontier db6f32c. It does not claim non-ASCII locale behavior or later excluded consumers.

entries.candidate: Rejected backreference candidates do not hide overlapping or same-start valid glibc matches
entries.reachability: A valid configured pattern can produce an ECMAScript candidate whose referenced optional group did not participate before glibc would choose another valid start or alternative.
entries.owner: js/posixregex.js regex_match() and reference-aware compiled representation
entries.effects: The configured MSGTYPE action is selected for every match glibc regexec accepts.
entries.evidence: Adjudicated repros include (a|(b))b?\2 on abb, ((a)?\2x.x|a) on xax, and a same-start valid alternative after an invalid empty-reference candidate.
entries.remaining: Model candidate choice without skipping overlap or same-start alternatives; add direct oracle and live MSGTYPE/config cases.

entries.candidate: Comma-only interval a{,} is accepted with glibc zero-or-more semantics
entries.reachability: The recorder ABI accepts the form in any startup regex.
entries.effects: Compile acceptance, installed rule, and empty/nonempty match results.
entries.evidence: Recorder glibc accepts a{,} and matches it as {0,}; current validation reports Invalid content of braces.
entries.remaining: Admit the form and pin direct compile/match plus live config behavior.

entries.candidate: GNU escaped backtick and apostrophe absolute-buffer anchors
entries.reachability: ASCII startup patterns may use either glibc extension and may attempt to quantify it.
entries.effects: Absolute beginning/end matches and Invalid preceding regular expression diagnostics.
entries.evidence: Recorder glibc matches escaped backtick only at input start, escaped apostrophe at input end, and rejects repetition; current JS treats both as repeatable punctuation.
entries.remaining: Translate both zero-width anchors, reject quantifiers, and add direct/live cases.

entries.candidate: Contextual internal caret and dollar behavior on newline-bearing text
entries.reachability: vpline preserves formatted newlines before MSGTYPE lookup, and startup diagnostic paths can emit them after window initialization.
entries.owner: js/posixregex.js anchor translation and live MSGTYPE matching
entries.effects: Internal-anchor match result without breaking absolute leading/trailing anchor behavior.
entries.evidence: Recorder glibc matches $. on newline, a$. on a-newline, and .+^ on newline while ^end$ still rejects end-newline; unconditional absolute JS anchors fail the internal cases.
entries.remaining: Derive a position-sensitive source model, pin absolute/internal oracle tables, and record a live newline-bearing path.

entries.reachability: Two different 256-511-byte raw messages can normalize to the same 255-byte vpline value.
entries.effects: The second normalized-equal message is suppressed with history/display/input unchanged.
entries.evidence: Current long-message tests pin lookup/render/history but never combine normalization with NOREP comparison.
entries.remaining: Add two distinct raw inputs with identical normalized bytes and assert source state.

entries.candidate: Same-line appended MSGTYP_STOP waits once and clears
entries.reachability: A short matching STOP message fits beside a short pending message.
entries.effects: Combined More screen, one consumed dismissal key, retained sentinel, then cleared row and cursor.
entries.evidence: Existing STOP cases force no-prior, too-long-prior, or wrapped branches and do not execute the fitting-current branch.
entries.remaining: Add the short-prior/short-STOP state and input-boundary assertions.

entries.candidate: Urgent messages bypass configured MSGTYP_NOREP suppression
entries.reachability: URGENT_MESSAGE still performs lookup but bypasses both NOSHOW and repeated-NOREP swallowing.
entries.effects: A repeated urgent message is rendered and stored.
entries.evidence: Existing urgent tests cover NOSHOW and STOP but never install a NOREP rule.
entries.remaining: Add ordinary-then-urgent repeated text under configured NOREP.

entries.candidate: Combined autounlock acting masks preserve bit tests and APPLY_KEY-before-KICK precedence
entries.reachability: Startup accepts APPLY_KEY|KICK|FORCE and doopen_indir reaches the locked-door consumer.
entries.effects: With a recognized tool, stop at tool use; without one, fall through to kick prompt before force.
entries.evidence: Live tests cover isolated bits only; combined mask 15 is parsed/displayed but not consumed.
entries.remaining: Add live combined-mask cases with and without a tool.

entries.candidate: Accepted interval, repeated-interval, and final-hyphen forms have semantic match tests
entries.reachability: Valid startup patterns traverse these validator/translator branches.
entries.effects: Positive and negative membership/repetition match glibc rather than only compiling.
entries.evidence: a{,2}, a{2}{3}, and [a-] are compile-only; adjacent a+? and a++ are already match-pinned.
entries.remaining: Add discriminating match/miss tables without duplicating covered adjacent-quantifier cases.

entries.candidate: UTF-8 vpline normalization is byte-based at the 249/255 boundaries
entries.reachability: A valid long message can split a multibyte sequence at byte 249; exactly 255 bytes remains unchanged.
entries.effects: Encoded history bytes retain the lone lead byte, ellipsis, and source final three bytes exactly.
entries.evidence: All current 256/300/511-byte cases are ASCII and cannot reject character-count slicing.
entries.remaining: Add split-multibyte and 255-byte control cases compared as raw encoded bytes.

entries.reachability: Validation resets path-available capture groups at each alternative; unioning siblings would accept invalid references.
entries.effects: Maintainers can preserve rejection of patterns such as (a)|\1.
entries.evidence: The invariant is currently encoded only by availableGroups assignments; recorder glibc rejects the sibling-only reference.
entries.remaining: Rename or comment the path-local set at the reset site and pin valid/invalid sibling examples.

entries.candidate: Compiled-regex representation has an explicit state contract
entries.reachability: regex_match dispatches among rejected, non-ASCII boundary, direct ASCII, and reference-aware ASCII states.
entries.effects: Legal matcher/reference combinations cannot silently drift through nullable-field conventions.
entries.evidence: Current dispatch infers four states from matcher, matchers, references, and pattern nullability without a declared discriminant.
entries.remaining: Use a compact discriminant or document the legal representation and retain all focused outcomes.

entries.candidate: ttyPlineCore names MSGTYP_NORMAL for its override default
entries.reachability: OVERRIDE_MSGTYPE bypasses lookup and relies on the initialized normal action.
entries.effects: The source semantic default is explicit rather than coupled to literal zero.
entries.evidence: pline.c initializes msgtyp to MSGTYP_NORMAL; JS uses 0 while importing other action constants.
entries.remaining: Import/use MSGTYP_NORMAL and retain override behavior.

entries.candidate: tty_message module header maps all ported source owners
entries.reachability: The module now contains topl.c, pline.c, and wintty.c branches.
entries.effects: Future reviewers can trace normalization, custom/urgent flags, and display/clear ordering to the correct C files.
entries.evidence: The header names only topl.c despite the reviewed pline.c and wintty.c ports.
entries.remaining: Expand the source/function map without changing behavior.

sourceReview: The expanded full audit and its two adjudicators source-confirmed all fourteen entries. Production fixes must be derived from the recorder ABI and pinned NetHack source, with exact compile diagnostics, match selection, input/wait ordering, screens/cursors, and no new PRNG effects. Mutation commands remain waived for this work session.
